scope: Local Docker proof of nginx to restricted reverse SSH to Caddy relay

components.ssh_client: OpenSSH_10.3p1 on pinned Alpine 3.24.2 index digest

limitations: The test used a synthetic upstream rather than the full application

No public certificate, external DNS, NAS runtime or VPS configuration was changed
Production nginx and sshd validation on ru2 remains mandatory before reload
